WITH phrs_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.envhealthregistry,
        eh.env_dist_ref,
        hr.hr_ops_ref as opsregistry,
        o.emerglevel,
        o.resp_phase,
        o.opsstatus,
        -- disease_risk_score
        CASE 
            WHEN eh.health_environment_profile::jsonb->'health'->>'disease_risk' = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN eh.health_environment_profile::jsonb->'health'->>'disease_risk' = 'Medium' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END as disease_risk_score,
        -- sanitation_risk
        COALESCE(100 - (eh.health_environment_profile::jsonb->'environment'->>'sanitation_coverage')::numeric, 100) as sanitation_risk,
        -- water_quality_risk
        COALESCE(100 - (eh.health_environment_profile::jsonb->'environment'->>'water_quality_index')::numeric, 100) as water_quality_risk,
        -- MSR: medical_personnel / (casualties + injured)
        (hr.staffing_details::jsonb->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric / 
            NULLIF((de.impact_summary::jsonb->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric + 
                   (de.impact_summary::jsonb->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0) as msr
    FROM environmentandhealth eh
    JOIN disasterevents de ON eh.env_dist_ref = de.distregistry
    JOIN humanresources hr ON hr.hrdistref = eh.env_dist_ref
    JOIN operations o ON hr.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
)
SELECT *,
    ((1 - COALESCE(msr, 0)) * 40) + (disease_risk_score * 10) + (sanitation_risk * 0.15) + (water_quality_risk * 0.15) as phrs
FROM phrs_calc;
